unit: m above local mean sea level

notes.wk: the mean of each week of the year (week 1 = 1-7 January, week 53 = the last 1 or 2 days) in each year 2011-2025, null where no value
notes.mon: monthly means from m0, null where a month has fewer than 15 daily values
notes.dropped: daily values left out: the years before the last year (before 2011) whose median is more than one 2011-2025 range outside it (another reference, or a reservoir still filling), and single values more than three ranges below the low or one above the high
notes.day: daily values from d0, null where missing
